demonstrations.scenario_abstract: For a fixed family beach day, a traveler separates cold food, a phone, towels, and wet clothes among a cooler bag, protected phone carrier, and ordinary clothing container so each bag handles only the exposure its contents require.
demonstrations.activation_path: beach swimming plus explicitly separated carriers -> splash intensity and dry-content consequence differ by bag role -> bags water-resistance preference becomes naturally expressible
demonstrations.activation_explanation: The complete parent explicitly lists a cooler bag, waterproof phone pouch, and plastic bags for wet clothes rather than one imaginary all-purpose beach bag.
demonstrations.value_expression_guidance: Use Waterproof for the phone carrier, Water Resistant for incidental splash around mostly dry contents, and Not Waterproof only where wet items already have separate containment and no dry valuables depend on the outer bag.
demonstrations.why_this_is_valid: The real beach task distinguishes protection levels through separate contents and consequences.
demonstrations.coverage_review_note: All three final values have natural positive use cases in the same beach scenario.
demonstrations.source_basis: Complete ThoughtTrace parent user206_task1_conversation1: the user fixes Beacon Bay Beach, a date, budget, sister and mother, swimming and beach walking; the packing list explicitly separates a cooler bag, waterproof phone pouch, and plastic bags for wet clothes.

quality_review.note: The second scenario preserves both the middle resistance level and the positive validity of Not Waterproof.

demonstrations.scenario_abstract_zh: 在固定的家庭海滩日中，旅客把冷食、手机、毛巾和湿衣物分别放入保冷包、手机防护袋和普通衣物包，使每只包只承担其内容物真正需要应对的暴露程度。

translation_review.semantic_scope: same event, grounding, and attribute-activation mechanism as scenario_abstract

attributes.pair_review_note: One named commuter backpack supplies concrete-item evidence under a fixed load, while a two-week hiking purchase supplies category-level evidence across lightweight and reinforced construction. The old invented comparison and weigh-in mechanisms were removed.

demonstrations.scenario_abstract: A new public-transport commuter evaluates one named laptop backpack with a fixed computer, notebooks, water, chargers, and small items, deciding whether its padding, organizer panels, robust hardware, and trolley sleeve justify how much weight the empty bag adds to the daily shoulder load.
demonstrations.activation_path: named backpack plus fixed commute load -> structure and empty-bag burden can be separated conceptually -> bags weight-class preference becomes naturally expressible
demonstrations.activation_explanation: The complete parent names the bag, fixes the contents, and repeatedly tests shoulder comfort, padding, construction, and overload.
demonstrations.value_expression_guidance: Use Very Lightweight when minimizing the bag's own load dominates, Lightweight for a moderate reduction, and Standard Weight when structure or durability justifies normal heft.
demonstrations.why_this_is_valid: The commute is central and comparison under equal contents makes all three values meaningful.
demonstrations.coverage_review_note: All three classes can be positively preferred under different structure-fatigue tradeoffs.
demonstrations.source_basis: Complete MMRC parent backpack_for_commuting/backpack_for_commuting: a new commuter evaluates one named Swissgear ScanSmart with a fixed laptop, notebooks, water, chargers, and small-item load through shoulder comfort, padding, construction, trolley sleeve, and overload advice.

quality_review.note: Controlling contents avoids confusing capacity with empty weight.

demonstrations.scenario_abstract_zh: 一名刚开始乘公共交通通勤的用户用固定的电脑、笔记本、水、充电器和小件物品评估一款有明确型号的背包，判断填充层、整理面板、坚固五金和行李箱套带是否值得每天额外承担空包重量。

translation_review.semantic_scope: same event, grounding, and attribute-activation mechanism as scenario_abstract

demonstrations.scenario_abstract: A traveler selecting one backpack for a two-week trip with hiking compares light synthetic bodies with reinforced panels, frames, harnesses, and hip belts, deciding how much extra empty-bag weight is justified by rough-route protection and better load transfer.
demonstrations.activation_path: two-week trip plus hiking -> backpack structure ranges from light fabric to reinforced frame -> bags weight-class preference becomes naturally expressible
demonstrations.activation_explanation: The complete parent explicitly contrasts lightweight nylon or polyester with reinforced construction and a stable hiking frame.
demonstrations.value_expression_guidance: Express Very Lightweight or Lightweight when base weight dominates, Standard Weight when harness structure earns moderate heft, and Heavy only when reinforced protection or a substantial frame is genuinely required by the route.
demonstrations.why_this_is_valid: One real purchase supplies a direct weight-versus-structure tradeoff across the complete domain.
demonstrations.coverage_review_note: All four classes can be positive choices under different route and structural requirements.
demonstrations.source_basis: Complete MMRC parent choose_backpack/choose_backpack: a traveler buys one backpack for two weeks with hiking and discusses lightweight nylon or polyester, reinforced panels, a stable frame, adjustable harness, and padded hip belt.

quality_review.note: Objective weighing complements the commute's bodily feedback.

demonstrations.scenario_abstract_zh: 一名旅客为包含徒步的两周行程选择背包，比较轻质合成包身与加固面板、框架、背负系统和腰带，判断粗糙路线防护与更好负重转移值得增加多少空包重量。

translation_review.semantic_scope: same event, grounding, and attribute-activation mechanism as scenario_abstract

attributes.pair_review_note: A two-week backpack purchase supplies category-level binding, while one explicitly described comic-character satchel supplies concrete-item evidence. Both demonstrations were rebuilt from complete real parent dialogues; the old invented parade and community-swap examples were removed.

demonstrations.scenario_abstract: A traveler buying one backpack for a two-week trip, including hiking, compares surface designs only after fit, capacity, access, and durability are settled, asking which designs will remain recognizable in transit without looking out of place on trail days.
demonstrations.activation_path: two-week trip plus hiking -> a backpack category is necessary -> recognition, styling, and trail use make its surface pattern consequential
demonstrations.activation_explanation: The complete parent is a real backpack purchase and explicitly leaves room for colors and patterns after functional screening.
demonstrations.value_expression_guidance: Express a later target as a backpack surface the traveler compares after functional requirements pass; do not claim every decorative motif is suitable for hiking or present in the source.
demonstrations.why_this_is_valid: The bag category, trip, hiking, fit test, and explicit interest in patterns all belong to one complete real dialogue.
demonstrations.coverage_review_note: Strong for Solid, Geometric, Striped, Plaid, Camouflage, Logo, Color Block, and Chevron; decorative motifs need other parents.
demonstrations.source_basis: Complete MMRC parent choose_backpack/choose_backpack: the user buys one backpack for a two-week trip with hiking and explicitly asks about colors and patterns after discussing fit, volume, access, security, material, budget, and inspection.

quality_review.note: This is category-level binding because a backpack is necessary but no purchased model is assumed.

demonstrations.scenario_abstract_zh: 一名旅客为包含徒步的两周行程购买背包，在贴合度、容量、取物和耐用性确定后才比较表面图案，判断哪些设计在转运时容易辨认，在徒步日又不会显得不合场合。

translation_review.semantic_scope: same event, grounding, and attribute-activation mechanism as scenario_abstract

demonstrations.scenario_abstract: While refining a recurring comic character, the writer keeps one worn leather satchel recognizable across scenes by arranging its mismatched fabric repairs to coordinate with the character's deliberately limited clothing palette.
demonstrations.activation_path: recurring character plus one identified patched satchel -> repeated illustrations must preserve its repair layout and visual identity -> bag pattern becomes observable
demonstrations.activation_explanation: The complete parent explicitly gives the character one worn leather satchel patched with different-colored fabrics, making surface construction part of a concrete item's continuity.
covered_value_domain: restrained graphic or cartoon repair motifs
demonstrations.value_expression_guidance: Keep later targets on the satchel's visible repair panels or established surface; do not replace the satchel or invent a resale event.
demonstrations.why_this_is_valid: One explicitly described satchel supplies product-level evidence inside a real character-design workflow.
weakly_covered_values: Graphic and Cartoon require a later target to be expressed as a visible repair motif rather than a new object
demonstrations.coverage_review_note: Patchwork and Color Block are direct; Graphic and Cartoon are conditional extensions of the established repair-panel mechanism.
demonstrations.source_basis: Complete ThoughtTrace parent user910_task2_conversation1: the user develops a recurring comic character with a muted two-outfit wardrobe and one worn leather satchel patched with different-colored fabrics.

quality_review.note: This is concrete-item binding because the same identified satchel must remain visually consistent across scenes.

demonstrations.scenario_abstract_zh: 在完善一个反复登场的漫画角色时，作者通过安排旧皮挎包上颜色各异的修补布，使这只包在不同场景中保持可辨识，并与角色刻意压缩过的服装配色协调。

translation_review.semantic_scope: same event, grounding, and attribute-activation mechanism as scenario_abstract

attributes.pair_review_note: A category-level student commute budget contrasts with a concrete carry-system fee and replacement calculation.

demonstrations.scenario_abstract: A student beginning a daily public-transport commute sets one ceiling for a bag that must carry a laptop, notebooks, water, and chargers, comparing in-store fit checks with online discounts while reserving part of the budget for study essentials.
demonstrations.activation_path: necessary daily carry role plus a bounded student budget -> comfort, protection, and channel discounts compete -> bags price becomes naturally expressible
demonstrations.activation_explanation: A bag is necessary to the commute, but any same-category option that satisfies the role can be compared.
covered_value_domain: accept a modest premium after an in-person fit test
wait for a discount when no current option justifies its price
demonstrations.value_expression_guidance: Express the later target through total affordability and justified tradeoffs without inventing a purchase outcome.
demonstrations.why_this_is_valid: The category role is indispensable while the exact bag remains open.
demonstrations.coverage_review_note: No discrete price domain exists; qualitative price directions replace value coverage.
demonstrations.source_basis: The complete MMRC commuting-backpack dialogue with an approximately USD 80 ceiling, a 15-inch laptop, notebooks, water, public transport, online discounts, in-store fitting, durability, and warranty.

quality_review.note: The bag category is necessary to the commute, while no single model is assumed in the abstract.

demonstrations.scenario_abstract_zh: 一名开始每日公共交通通勤的学生为必须装下电脑、笔记本、水和充电器的包设定价格上限，在实体店试背与网购折扣之间比较，同时为学习必需品保留部分预算。

translation_review.semantic_scope: same event, grounding, and attribute-activation mechanism as scenario_abstract

demonstrations.scenario_abstract: Before booking a low-cost flight, the user compares keeping a familiar carrier within the included under-seat allowance, paying for a cabin case, or buying a different bag, calculating fees across both directions and whether the new item will be reused.
demonstrations.activation_path: concrete carrier plus fare rules and alternatives -> fee avoidance competes with purchase and reuse -> bags price becomes relevant
demonstrations.activation_explanation: The exact luggage allowance, existing item, and purchase options mediate the outcome.
covered_value_domain: buy only when repeated reuse offsets the price
demonstrations.value_expression_guidance: Express the target as total trip cost rather than isolated shelf price.
demonstrations.why_this_is_valid: Changing the concrete carrier or fare changes the decision.
demonstrations.coverage_review_note: Qualitative review covers zero-purchase, fee, and investment directions.
demonstrations.source_basis: Frozen real dialogue about an included under-seat allowance, a paid cabin case, and deciding whether tighter packing is worth the fare difference.

quality_review.note: The ownership and airline constraints make this unambiguously product-bound.

demonstrations.scenario_abstract_zh: 预订廉价航班前，用户比较让熟悉的包保持在免费座位下额度内、付费增加登机箱，或另买一只包，并计算往返费用以及新包日后是否会继续使用。

translation_review.semantic_scope: same event, grounding, and attribute-activation mechanism as scenario_abstract
